description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'LocalPlayer' that manages media playback using Android's MediaPlayer, including subclasses for SurfaceView and overlay display playback. It handles media controls, surface management, and interactions with presentation displays.

classes.name: LocalPlayer
classes.description: Handles media playback using MediaPlayer, manages surface setup, playback states, and provides base for different playback display modes.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.SurfaceViewPlayer
classes.description: Subclass of LocalPlayer that manages media playback within a SurfaceView, handling surface lifecycle and display size adjustments.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.OverlayPlayer
classes.description: Subclass of LocalPlayer that manages media playback overlay windows, handling window creation and destruction.

classes.name: DemoPresentation
classes.description: Inner class for presenting media content on a separate display, managing layout and surface size.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a media route; overridden to handle route-specific logic.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases media resources and dismisses presentations.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of a PlaylistItem, setting data source and preparing MediaPlayer.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the media.

methods.name: onPrepared
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when preparation is complete.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when media playback completes.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when an error occurs.

methods.name: onSeekComplete
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when seeking is complete.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Abstract method for adjusting video size, implemented in subclasses.
